Root cause is `dep-4471`, the gateway connection-per-request config. It burns the 20 slot pool. Churn hits 4180 opens per 5m against a baseline of 40.

Window is `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z`, still open at the last log line. 530 of 636 requests failed, or 83%. Only `/health` still returns 200, since it takes no connection.

Roll back `dep-4471` on `gateway`. Then check nodes 1 and 2. This log is `node-3 of 3`.
